nodes.label: Deserialization Failed

ambiguities.text: No explicit rate limiting or DoS protection specified for light client gossip topics
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard gossipsub scoring and rate limiting apply to light client topics. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: The mapping from fork version to SSZ type for genesis fork version is listed as 'n/a' without specifying behavior
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume no light client messages are valid at genesis fork version. Messages received claiming genesis version should be rejected. This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: Light clients trust that at least one honest full node is serving correct light client updates
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A light client could be fed false finality or optimistic updates, leading to acceptance of an invalid chain

implicit_assumptions.description: The fork schedule is known and consistent across all nodes, so fork-version-to-SSZ-type mapping is deterministic
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes on different fork schedules would reject each other's valid messages, causing network partitioning
